skill.summary: Extract YouTube transcripts and metadata through BrowserAct.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: The skill performs the advertised BrowserAct workflow calls and most static findings are Markdown or identifier false positives. Confirmed risks are third-party network use, environment-secret access, a local script execution path, and unsafe instructions that encourage users to provide an API key to the agent.

remediation.issue: Instructions ask users to provide the BrowserAct API key to the agent.
remediation.suggestion: Require users to set BROWSERACT_API_KEY in their local environment and remove wording that asks them to paste or provide the key in chat.

remediation.issue: The skill sends user video URLs and authenticated requests to BrowserAct.
remediation.suggestion: State the third-party data flow clearly and avoid sending any unrelated user data in workflow parameters.

remediation.issue: The skill relies on a shell command that includes a user-provided URL argument.
remediation.suggestion: Document that URLs must be passed as a single quoted argument, and validate supported YouTube URL formats before calling the API.

content.value_statement: Manual YouTube transcript collection is slow and inconsistent. This skill runs a BrowserAct workflow to fetch transcripts and video metadata from a provided URL.
actual_capabilities: Runs the bundled Python script for a YouTube video URL.
Submits a BrowserAct workflow task with the configured template ID.
Polls BrowserAct until the task finishes, fails, or times out.
Retrieves video title, publisher, channel link, likes count, video URL, and transcript when available.
Reports BrowserAct authorization and task errors from the API response.
limitations: Requires a valid BROWSERACT_API_KEY before use.
Sends the target YouTube URL to BrowserAct's hosted API.
Depends on BrowserAct workflow availability and YouTube page accessibility.
May wait up to several minutes while polling for completion.

use_cases.title: Research Video Evidence
use_cases.description: Collect transcripts and publisher metadata for videos used in media or policy research.

use_cases.title: Prepare Knowledge Summaries
use_cases.description: Fetch transcript text before creating summaries for internal notes or learning libraries.

use_cases.title: Review Channel Content
use_cases.description: Gather video titles, channel links, likes, and transcripts for content analysis workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Extract One Transcript
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the transcript and basic metadata for this YouTube URL: [URL].

prompt_templates.title: Summarize A Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Get the transcript for [URL], then summarize the main points and list notable claims.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Several Videos
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract transcripts for these YouTube URLs and compare the recurring themes: [URLs].

prompt_templates.title: Build A Source Table
prompt_templates.prompt: For each URL in this list, extract available transcript and metadata, then create a source table with publisher, title, likes, and key topics.

output_examples.input: Extract the transcript for a YouTube lecture URL.
output: Likes count and channel link included when available.

output_examples.input: Summarize a product announcement video after extraction.
output: Main announcements summarized in concise bullets.

output_examples.input: Compare three interviews from different channels.
output: Common themes and differences are listed.
Publisher and channel details are attached to each source.

best_practices: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY as an environment variable before running the skill.
Use direct YouTube video URLs and verify that you have rights to process the content.
Review long transcripts before using them in reports or automated pipelines.
anti_patterns: Paste API keys into chat or shared logs.
Use playlist, channel, or search URLs when a single video URL is required.
Retry failed jobs repeatedly without checking BrowserAct authorization or task status.

faq.question: Does this skill need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY to authenticate with the BrowserAct workflow API.

faq.question: What data can it return?
faq.answer: It can return transcript text, video title, video URL, publisher, channel link, and likes count when available.

faq.question: Does it download the video file?
faq.answer: No. It is designed to extract transcript and metadata, not media files.

faq.question: Where is the request sent?
faq.answer: The bundled script sends workflow requests to the BrowserAct API endpoint configured in the skill.

faq.question: Can it process private or restricted videos?
faq.answer: Only if the BrowserAct workflow can access the video and transcript. Restricted content may fail.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
